sections.name: pricing
sections.title: Start free. Grow at your own pace.
sections.description: Free includes one storefront link and 10 lifetime eligible verified sales. Pro offers unlimited eligible verified sales while active. Linket takes 0% commission on new creator sales; the displayed plan price comes from current billing settings.

sections.name: faq
sections.title: Questions before you get started
sections.description: A few useful details about selling with Linket.

questions.question: What can I sell on Linket?
questions.answer: Publish eligible ebooks, guides, templates, courses, digital downloads, and creator services from your storefront.

questions.question: How do customers pay me?
questions.answer: Customers pay your approved receiving account directly through supported Ethiopian payment methods. Linket verifies eligible payments before allowing paid digital content to be accessed.

questions.question: Can I start for free?
questions.answer: Yes. Free includes one storefront link and 10 lifetime eligible verified sales. Active Pro offers unlimited eligible verified sales.

questions.question: Does Linket take a commission?
questions.answer: Linket's commission on new creator sales is 0%. Any fees charged by an external payment provider are separate.
